reasoning: As of March 2026, the Iranian regime has survived decades of sanctions, protests (including 2022-2023 Woman Life Freedom movement), and internal challenges. While the regime faces economic pressure and succession concerns around the aging Supreme Leader Khamenei, there are no credible reports of imminent collapse. The IRGC maintains strong control, and regime change within ~2 months would require an extraordinarily rapid and unprecedented collapse. Historical precedent shows authoritarian regimes rarely fall this quickly without major external intervention or military defection, neither of which appears imminent.
